title: Slovakian Skillet with Reblochon and Smoky Flavor
description: A hearty Slovakian-inspired dish featuring smoky sausage, melted Reblochon cheese, and a skillet-cooked twist.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook the sliced onions until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced potatoes and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and cook at 400°F (200°C) for 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
